name: Powell Industries, Inc.

profile.end_markets: FY2025 revenue mix: oil & gas 37%, electric utility 25%, commercial & other industrial 16%, petrochemical 14%, light-rail traction 4%, other 4% (FY2025 10-K)
profile.products: Custom-engineered power distribution & control: integrated power control room substations (PCR), E-Houses/modules, traditional & arc-resistant distribution switchgear and control gear, medium-voltage circuit breakers, motor control centers, switches and bus duct; application voltages 480 V–38 kV (ANSI & IEC); field services. Powell does NOT make power/distribution transformers (it protects/controls them); UK SCADA/RTU substation automation added Aug-2025.
